title.zh: 第一轮：Opus 5.5 对 GPT-6 Astra（精简题库）
title.en: Round 1: Opus 5.5 vs GPT-6 Astra (lite set)

note: 从 31 道题库里每个维度挑两道（都是样题，每维一易一难），每题每家只跑一次，思考档位都是各家第二高的 xhigh。

S1.zh: 剪贴板 App 数据层：两台 Mac 同步来的同一条置顶，去重时留下的不一样
S1.en: Clipboard app data layer: duplicate pins synced from two Macs are deduplicated differently

rule.zh: 判对错：用隐藏测试替换对应的测试文件，`swift test` 全过记 100，有挂或编不过记 0。
rule.en: Correctness: the hidden test replaces the matching test file; `swift test` passing completely scores 100, any failure or a build error scores 0.

rationale.结构与分层: 只在 CloudMerge 两个比较函数里改按整秒比，加私有 wholeSecond，测试放对文件，改动面小。
rationale.可读性: wholeSecond 命名直白，注释讲清为何向下取整及残余风险，测试用 macs 数组模拟两台 Mac，好读。
rationale.一致性: 沿用原有元组比较与中文注释风格，测试复用 insertRemotePinned 等已有辅助方法。
rationale.稳健写法: 按参考日期向下取整，lastUsedAt 一并按整秒比；未覆盖整秒边界和负时间戳等情形。
rationale.可维护性: 两个测试分别覆盖 Pinned 与 Pinboard 两条去重路径，直接复现两台 Mac 各选各的，无夹带改动。

rationale_en.结构与分层: Only the two comparison functions in CloudMerge change to whole-second comparison, via a private wholeSecond helper; tests go in the right file and the change is small.
rationale_en.可读性: wholeSecond is plainly named and its comment explains why it rounds down and what risk remains; the tests model two Macs with a macs array and read well.
rationale_en.一致性: Keeps the existing tuple comparison and comment style; the tests reuse existing helpers such as insertRemotePinned.
rationale_en.稳健写法: Rounds down from the reference date and compares lastUsedAt at whole seconds too; does not cover the second boundary or negative timestamps.
rationale_en.可维护性: Two tests cover the Pinned and Pinboard deduplication paths and reproduce the two Macs choosing differently; no unrelated changes.

rationale.结构与分层: 修复同样集中在 CloudMerge 比较函数与私有 wholeSecond，测试放对文件，无越界改动。
rationale.可读性: wholeSecond 无注释，测试里 localID == a ? b : a 等三元较绕，单个测试反复改模型字段。
rationale.一致性: 沿用元组比较并把原注释的『待真机核实』改成实际做法；新测试直接构造模型测内部函数，与原集成测试风格不同。
rationale.稳健写法: 参数化测试覆盖 0.9999/1.0 与负时间戳的整秒边界、全字段相同不删的规则，并核对库里实际副本数。
rationale.可维护性: 测试覆盖面广，但两个参数化函数同时测 Pinboard 与 Pinned、手工改字段多，字段顺序一改就要跟着改。

rationale_en.结构与分层: The fix is likewise limited to the CloudMerge comparison functions and a private wholeSecond helper; tests are in the right file, nothing out of scope.
rationale_en.可读性: wholeSecond has no comment; the tests use convoluted ternaries such as localID == a ? b : a, and one test keeps mutating model fields.
rationale_en.一致性: Keeps the tuple comparison and replaces the old "verify on device" comment with what it actually does; the new tests build models and test internals directly, unlike the existing integration-style tests.
rationale_en.稳健写法: Parameterized tests cover the 0.9999/1.0 second boundary, negative timestamps and the rule that fully identical items are kept, and check the actual copy count in the store.
rationale_en.可维护性: Broad coverage, but two parameterized functions test Pinboard and Pinned at once with many hand-edited fields, so a change in field order breaks them.

S2.zh: 剪贴板 App 数据层：搜索翻页回到开头、Pinboard 拖不动（只写现象）
S2.en: Clipboard app data layer: search paging jumps back to the start, Pinboard items won't move (symptoms only)

rule.zh: 判对错：8 个隐藏回归用例，过几个算几分（每个 12.5）；其他测试有挂、或原有 38 个测试少了，分数减半；编不过 0 分。
rule.en: Correctness: 8 hidden regression tests, 12.5 points each; halved if any other test fails or any of the 38 original tests is missing; 0 if it does not build.

rationale.结构与分层: 翻页只把游标时间传进 search，保留 rowid 即时间的原设计；排序修在合并排序与挪动两处。
rationale.可读性: 注释讲清中点等于邻居会弹回、游标条目被删或前移的原因；search 里按探测窗口取实际 rowid 的判断稍绕。
rationale.一致性: 魔法数 8 提成 rankProbeLimit 复用，新 rank(of:) 沿用原有写法并区分无行与出错。
rationale.稳健写法: 新键须严格落在两邻居之间，否则整体重排且跳过未变的记录；同毫秒碰撞加游标被删时仍有极端漏重可能。
rationale.可维护性: 测试覆盖 trigram 与短词两路、60 组拖动和 80 次挤缝；moved 辅助函数复刻了夹取逻辑。

rationale_en.结构与分层: Paging only passes the cursor time into search, keeping the original "rowid is time" design; the ordering fix is in the merge sort and in moving.
rationale_en.可读性: Comments explain why a midpoint equal to a neighbor bounces back and what happens when the cursor item is deleted or moved; the probe-window check for the real rowid in search is a bit convoluted.
rationale_en.一致性: The magic number 8 becomes a reused rankProbeLimit constant, and the new rank(of:) follows the existing style and tells "no row" apart from an error.
rationale_en.稳健写法: A new key must fall strictly between its two neighbors or the list is renumbered, skipping unchanged items; a same-millisecond collision combined with a deleted cursor can still, in extreme cases, skip or repeat an item.
rationale_en.可维护性: Tests cover both the trigram and short-query paths, 60 drag sequences and 80 squeezes into a gap; the moved test helper duplicates the clamping logic.

rationale.结构与分层: 为修翻页把索引升到 schema 2，加新列、两个索引、JOIN 查询和原地升级，超出修 bug 所需。
rationale.可读性: search 拼接多段 SQL 字符串，绑定序号靠 cursor == nil ? 2 : 4 推算，不易一眼看清。
rationale.一致性: 弃用 rowid 即时间的原设计、删掉实测性能注释，Entry 改字段牵动旧测试，索引层依赖 ClipCursor。
rationale.稳健写法: 按（时间, uuid）翻页，同毫秒也不漏不重；isFinite 与升级置待修补周到，但升级后列可空与新建不一致。
rationale.可维护性: 补了迁移测试和同毫秒翻页测试，覆盖较全，但引入 schema 迁移与查询计划提示，后续维护负担明显加重。

rationale_en.结构与分层: Upgrades the index to schema 2 to fix paging, adding a column, two indexes, a JOIN query and an in-place migration, far beyond what the bug needs.
rationale_en.可读性: search concatenates several SQL strings, and bind positions have to be worked out from cursor == nil ? 2 : 4; hard to read at a glance.
rationale_en.一致性: Drops the original "rowid is time" design and removes a measured performance comment; changing Entry fields forces old tests to change, and the index layer now depends on ClipCursor.
rationale_en.稳健写法: Pages by (time, uuid), so nothing is skipped or repeated even within the same millisecond; the isFinite checks and repair-on-upgrade are careful, but after the upgrade the column is nullable, unlike in new databases.
rationale_en.可维护性: Adds migration and same-millisecond paging tests with good coverage, but the schema migration and query-plan hints add a clear ongoing maintenance burden.

F2.zh: 照录屏复刻 Trovy 的统计报表页和房间详情页
F2.en: Rebuild Trovy's stats report and room detail screens from a recording

rule.zh: 同 F1：编译安装是门槛；自动比对 7 个状态占 30%；录屏评分三项占 70%。
rule.en: Same as F1: building and installing is the gate; automatic comparison of 7 states, 30%; video review on three axes, 70%.

rationale.静态还原: 两页布局、配色、字号、文字和数字与原录屏几乎一致，上滑停稳位置也对。扣1分：卡片底色偏灰，不如原录屏暖白。
rationale.动效还原: 数字逐位滚动、扇区淡入淡出、扫环、横条生长和数字从0滚上都与原录屏同步。扣1分：7.3秒页面推入慢约0.1秒；1.6秒中心小字晚一帧才换成Clothing。
rationale.交互手感: 六次操作全部生效，左边缘右滑正常返回并保留滚动位置，无闪烁。扣1分：9.4秒右滑返回的页面位移比原录屏落后约0.1秒。

rationale_en.静态还原: Layout, colors, type sizes, text and numbers on both pages match the original closely, and the scroll settles at the same spot. −1: card fill is greyer than the original's warm white.
rationale_en.动效还原: Digit rolling, segment fade in/out, ring sweep, bar growth and count-up from 0 stay in sync with the original. −1: the push at 7.3 s is ~0.1 s slower; at 1.6 s the center caption switches to Clothing one frame late.
rationale_en.交互手感: All six operations work; the left-edge swipe returns to the report page and keeps its scroll position, with no flicker. −1: the swipe-back page movement at 9.4 s trails the original by ~0.1 s.

rationale.静态还原: 两页卡片布局、配色、字号、图例和数字都几乎一致。扣1分：卡片底色偏灰，不如原录屏暖白；上滑停稳后比原录屏多滚了几点。
rationale.动效还原: 滚动、淡化、扫环和横条生长都有。扣4分：三次点选过渡中途淡化扇区闪回全彩（2.1、3.0、5.0秒）；1.6秒起步晚0.2秒；扫环、横条和推入慢约0.3秒。
rationale.交互手感: 点选、取消、上滑和点Bedroom进详情都生效，没有跳错页。扣5分：9.33秒左边缘右滑完全没有返回，最后一直停在Bedroom详情页。

rationale_en.静态还原: Card layout, colors, type sizes, legends and numbers on both pages match closely. −1: card fill is greyer than the original's warm white; the scroll settles a few points further down.
rationale_en.动效还原: Digit rolling, segment dimming, ring sweep and bar growth are all present. −4: dimmed segments flash back to full color mid-transition on all three taps (2.1, 3.0, 5.0 s); the 1.6 s change starts ~0.2 s late; ring sweep, bars and push run ~0.3 s behind.
rationale_en.交互手感: Segment taps, deselect, scroll and the Bedroom tap all work with no wrong navigation. −5: the left-edge swipe at 9.33 s does not go back at all; the replay stays on the Bedroom detail page.

F1.zh: 照录屏复刻美食地图 App 的三步引导页，含插画动画
F1.en: Rebuild a food-map app's three-step onboarding from a recording, illustrations animated

rule.zh: 先要编译通过、装得上（不然 0 分）。自动比对占 30%：回放后三步演完的停稳画面和原录屏比相似度（空白工程 0、原录屏 100）。录屏评分占 70%：静态还原、动效还原、交互手感各 1–10 分，平均 × 10，每少 1 分，本题少约 2.3 分。
rule.en: It must build and install, or it scores 0. Automatic comparison, 30%: the three settled screens after replay are compared with the original (an empty project scores 0, the original 100). Video review, 70%: static fidelity, motion and interaction feel, 1–10 each, averaged × 10; each point lost costs about 2.3 points on the task.

rationale.静态还原: 三步演完的画面和原录屏几乎重合，布局、配色、字体、插画位置都对上；原录屏里几处用系统字体的文字也照着改了。不扣分。
rationale.动效还原: 入场先后、间隔和缓动对到约一帧，第 3 步纸飞机路线、到店时间、「到了」气泡和小店回弹几乎逐帧一致。扣 1 分：App 出来时先整体淡入，整段比原录屏晚开演约 0.4 秒。
rationale.交互手感: 两次点「下一步」翻页都是两页一起推，标题错开的节奏也一样。扣 1 分：同样因为开头淡入，启动后的第一屏出来得慢半拍。

rationale_en.静态还原: The three settled screens nearly overlap the original: layout, colors, fonts and illustration positions all match, including a few texts that use the system font in the original. No deduction.
rationale_en.动效还原: Entrance order, spacing and easing match to about a frame; in step 3 the paper plane's route, arrival time, the "arrived" bubble and the shop's bounce line up almost frame by frame. −1: the app fades in at launch, so the whole sequence starts about 0.4 s late.
rationale_en.交互手感: Both taps on "Next" push the two pages together with the same staggered titles as the original. −1: because of the launch fade-in, the first screen appears half a beat late.

rationale.静态还原: 整体布局、配色、字体接近，数字「2000」和逐位滚动也对。扣 1 分：第 1 步便签卡和面碗的位置偏了（便签整体偏下，碗偏右下），第 3 步虚线路线的弯法和原录屏不一样。
rationale.动效还原: 第 2、3 步的动画接近原录屏。扣 3 分：第 1 步开头卡了约 0.75 秒（这段录屏没有新帧），之后第三个头像和便签出来得晚，打字效果几乎一闪而过。
rationale.交互手感: 点「下一步」也是两页一起推。扣 2 分：翻页比原录屏快，加上开头的卡顿，第一次点按前的等待感和原录屏不同。

rationale_en.静态还原: Layout, colors and fonts are close, and the counter reads "2000" and rolls digit by digit like the original. −1: in step 1 the note card sits lower and the noodle bowl further right and down, and in step 3 the dotted route curves differently from the original.
rationale_en.动效还原: Steps 2 and 3 animate close to the original. −3: step 1 stalls for about 0.75 s right after launch (no new frames recorded), then the third avatar and the note card arrive late and the typing effect is almost instant.
rationale_en.交互手感: Tapping "Next" also pushes both pages together. −2: the page transition runs faster than the original, and with the stall at launch the wait before the first tap feels different.

B4.zh: 按需求搭会员订阅回调服务（17 条隐藏验收）
B4.en: Build a subscription webhook service from a spec (17 hidden checks)

rule.zh: 判对错：17 条隐藏接口验收（鉴权、校验、状态流转、重复和乱序推送、10 路并发、字段完整），按通过比例给分。代码质量同 B2。
rule.en: Correctness: 17 hidden API checks (auth, validation, state transitions, duplicate and out-of-order events, 10 concurrent deliveries, complete fields), scored by the share passed. Code quality as in B2.

rationale.结构与分层: 鉴权、请求解析、数据库读写、状态推导各成一个模块，纯函数与读写分开；响应和日志助手仍堆在入口文件里
rationale.可读性: deriveSubscription 按发生顺序折叠事件，注释清楚；循环内解构赋值和日志的嵌套三元稍绕
rationale.一致性: 错误码风格统一并集中在助手函数；但只有 400 带说明，product_id 允许空串而其他字符串字段要求非空
rationale.稳健写法: 参数化插入冲突即忽略，令牌哈希后常数时间比较；但校验后靠 as string 强转，查询读出全部事件在内存排序
rationale.可维护性: 事件类型只定义一处，EFFECTS 穷举映射；单测含全排列乱序验证；但端到端用无种子随机洗牌，启动靠匹配日志文字

rationale_en.结构与分层: Auth, request parsing, database access and state derivation each get their own module, keeping pure logic apart from I/O; response and logging helpers still sit in the entry file.
rationale_en.可读性: deriveSubscription folds events in occurrence order with clear doc comments; the destructuring assignment inside the loop and the nested ternary for the log outcome are a bit convoluted.
rationale_en.一致性: Error codes follow one style and come from shared helpers; but only 400s include a message, and product_id may be an empty string while other string fields must be non-empty.
rationale_en.稳健写法: A parameterized insert that ignores conflicts, plus constant-time comparison of hashed tokens; but fields are force-cast with `as string` after validation, and every lookup loads all of a user's events and sorts them in memory.
rationale_en.可维护性: Event types are defined once and EFFECTS maps them exhaustively; unit tests check every arrival permutation. But the end-to-end tests shuffle with an unseeded random, and server startup is detected by matching log text.

rationale.结构与分层: 校验和权益计算抽到 subscriptions.ts，但 index.ts 兼管路由、鉴权和内联 SQL，缺独立数据访问层
rationale.可读性: 命名清楚、注释交代设计；但查询靠两个相关子查询拼字段，toSubscription 的三元判断偏紧凑
rationale.一致性: 错误统一走 json()，均为 {error} 形式且先鉴权后判方法；但 405 两处内联拼写，错误体没有机器可读的错误码
rationale.稳健写法: 单条参数化插入靠主键冲突忽略去重，读时按事件时间取最新并有部分索引和 CHECK 约束；令牌用 === 比较，非常数时间
rationale.可维护性: 测试覆盖全面，含确定性乱序并发与注入写入故障；但六种事件类型在索引、视图和 TS 映射三处各写一遍，测试为无类型 .mjs

rationale_en.结构与分层: Validation and entitlement logic live in subscriptions.ts, but index.ts mixes routing, auth and inline SQL with no separate data-access layer.
rationale_en.可读性: Clear names and comments that explain intent, but the lookup query stitches fields together with correlated subqueries and toSubscription's ternary logic is terse.
rationale_en.一致性: All errors go through json() as {error}, with auth checked before method; but the 405 response is built inline twice and errors carry no machine-readable code.
rationale_en.稳健写法: A single parameterized insert that ignores primary-key conflicts handles dedup; reads take the latest by event time, backed by a partial index and CHECK constraints. Tokens are compared with ===, which is not constant-time.
rationale_en.可维护性: Thorough tests, including deterministic out-of-order concurrency and injected write failures; but the six event types are listed three times (index, view, TS map) and the tests are untyped .mjs.

B2.zh: 按需求从零搭家庭物品与过期提醒服务（49 条隐藏验收）
B2.en: Build a household inventory and expiry-reminder service from a spec (49 hidden checks)

rule.zh: 判对错：49 条隐藏接口验收（功能 22、鉴权与隔离 13、健壮性 14），按通过比例给分。代码质量五项各 1–10 分，平均 × 10；每少 1 分，本题少 0.6 分。
rule.en: Correctness: 49 hidden API checks (22 features, 13 auth and isolation, 14 robustness), scored by the share passed. Code quality: five criteria, 1–10 each, averaged × 10; each point lost costs 0.6 on the task.

rationale.结构与分层: 按资源分 handlers，路由表带鉴权标记，http/validate/db/dates/cursor/crypto 各自独立
rationale.可读性: 命名清楚，并发取舍有注释；列表接口约 85 行偏长、动态拼 UPDATE 略绕
rationale.一致性: 统一 HttpError 和错误响应，校验集中，处理 405，越权一律 404
rationale.稳健写法: 全参数化；条件写入和批处理防竞争；会话只存哈希；防邮箱探测；约 10 处非空断言，外键未按家庭复合约束
rationale.可维护性: 常量命名，零重复，接口测试 1042 行加 node:test 单元测试

rationale_en.结构与分层: Handlers split by resource behind a routing table with auth flags; http, validate, db, dates, cursor and crypto each in their own module.
rationale_en.可读性: Clear names and comments on concurrency trade-offs; the list endpoint is about 85 lines and the dynamically built UPDATE is a bit convoluted.
rationale_en.一致性: One HttpError type and one error response format, validation in one place, 405 handled, and any cross-household access returns 404.
rationale_en.稳健写法: Fully parameterized SQL; conditional writes and batches prevent races; sessions are stored as hashes; email probing is prevented. About 10 non-null assertions, and foreign keys are not composite per household.
rationale_en.可维护性: Named constants, no duplication, 1,042 lines of API tests plus node:test unit tests.

rationale.结构与分层: 按资源分模块，HouseholdDB 把鉴权和操作放进同一批处理很巧；但路由是一长串手写判断，校验函数放在 http 模块
rationale.可读性: 代码密、长行多，SQL 片段靠 ?1/?2/?3 位置约定拼接，as unknown as 强转多
rationale.一致性: 统一 fail()；但所有请求都先解析请求体，未知路径先回 401，竞态不变量失败抛 500
rationale.稳健写法: 数据库约束最严（复合外键、层级 CHECK、唯一 owner、触发器原子加入），每条语句复查成员；令牌无状态不能撤销，依赖 TOKEN_SECRET
rationale.可维护性: 精简少重复；有魔法数（86_400_000），PATCH 预查两次，测试 490 行

rationale_en.结构与分层: Modules by resource, and HouseholdDB cleverly puts the auth check and the operation in one batch; but routing is a long hand-written chain of conditions and validators live in the http module.
rationale_en.可读性: Dense code with long lines; SQL fragments rely on ?1/?2/?3 position conventions, and there are many as unknown as casts.
rationale_en.一致性: One fail() helper; but every request parses its body first, unknown paths answer 401 before 404, and a failed race invariant throws a 500.
rationale_en.稳健写法: The strictest database constraints (composite foreign keys, depth CHECKs, a single owner, a trigger for atomic joins), and membership is re-checked in every statement; tokens are stateless and cannot be revoked, and depend on TOKEN_SECRET.
rationale_en.可维护性: Compact with little duplication; a magic number (86_400_000), PATCH looks the row up twice, 490 lines of tests.

R5.zh: 用 ShipSwift 组件加「编辑习惯」和全局提示
R5.en: Add habit editing and a global toast with ShipSwift components

rule.zh: 判对错：先要能编译；再看 9 条静态检查（提示组件的用法、挂载位置、不等弹窗关闭、不自己做横幅、不写 iOS 18 兼容分支、不改 ShipSwift 源码和工程设置），违反一条扣一条的分。代码质量同 B2。
rule.en: Correctness: it must build; then 9 static checks (alert component usage, where it is attached, no waiting for the sheet to close, no hand-made banners, no iOS 18 compatibility branches, ShipSwift sources and project settings untouched), each violation costs its share. Code quality as in B2.

rationale.结构与分层: 新建 HabitEditView，列表用 sheet(item:) 弹出，swAlert 挂在 App 入口，分层清楚。
rationale.可读性: draft 计算属性把可选的改动叠在 store 实时数据上，再配自定义 Binding，不够直观。
rationale.一致性: 按钮用 SW 按钮样式，成败都走 SWAlertManager，不等 sheet 关闭，符合组件约定。
rationale.稳健写法: 保存中禁用按钮和下滑关闭，色块带无障碍标签与选中态；Preview 直接取 habits[0]。
rationale.可维护性: 手搭表单与色块，32、44、16 等尺寸散落在代码里，代码量约为系统 Form 写法的两倍。

rationale_en.结构与分层: New HabitEditView, presented from the list with sheet(item:), with swAlert attached at the app entry; clear layering.
rationale_en.可读性: A computed draft property layers optional edits over the store's live data, combined with custom Bindings; not intuitive.
rationale_en.一致性: Buttons use the SW button styles, success and failure both go through SWAlertManager without waiting for the sheet to close, as the component docs require.
rationale_en.稳健写法: Disables the button and swipe-to-dismiss while saving, and the color swatches have accessibility labels and selected state; the Preview simply takes habits[0].
rationale_en.可维护性: Hand-built form and swatches with sizes such as 32, 44 and 16 scattered through the code, about twice the code of a system Form.

rationale.结构与分层: 新建 HabitEditView，列表用 sheet(item:) 弹出，swAlert 挂在 App 入口，改动集中。
rationale.可读性: @State draft 由 init 注入，Form 里输入框与 Picker 直接绑定 $draft，一眼看懂。
rationale.一致性: 按钮用 swPrimary、swSecondary，提示走 SWAlertManager，颜色选择用系统 Picker。
rationale.稳健写法: save 先 guard !isSaving 防重复点击，defer 复位状态，保存期间禁用表单与下滑关闭。
rationale.可维护性: 依赖系统 Form 与 Picker，几乎没有魔法数，无夹带改动；没有加 Preview。

rationale_en.结构与分层: New HabitEditView, presented from the list with sheet(item:), with swAlert attached at the app entry; the change is focused.
rationale_en.可读性: A @State draft injected through init, with the text fields and Picker in a Form bound directly to $draft; clear at a glance.
rationale_en.一致性: Buttons use swPrimary and swSecondary, alerts go through SWAlertManager, and the color choice uses the system Picker.
rationale_en.稳健写法: save starts with guard !isSaving against double taps and resets state with defer; the form and swipe-to-dismiss are disabled while saving.
rationale_en.可维护性: Relies on the system Form and Picker with almost no magic numbers and no unrelated changes; no Preview added.

R9.zh: 健身 App 加花费页，避开四份文档里写明的坑
R9.en: Add an expenses screen to a fitness app without hitting the pitfalls in four docs

rule.zh: 判对错：两道门（能编译、真的做了需求）不过记 0；再看 14 条静态检查（该用的组件、按地区解析金额和日期、纯日期不按 UTC 解析等），违反一条扣一条的分。代码质量同 B2。
rule.en: Correctness: two gates (it builds; the feature is really implemented), failing either scores 0; then 14 static checks (the right components, locale-aware amounts and dates, no UTC parsing of date-only values and more), each violation costs its share. Code quality as in B2.

rationale.结构与分层: 拆成 ExpenseDay、LocalMoney、ExpenseStore 与视图，日期、金额、数据、界面各管一块。
rationale.可读性: 注释讲清本地正午、系统解析过宽等原因；parse 与 recentAdds 的 generation 逻辑偏密。
rationale.一致性: KPI 卡、状态徽章、添加面板、页面加载都用 SW 组件，按文档在枚举末尾加 expenses。
rationale.稳健写法: 整串严格解析金额、本地正午解析日期，处理取消与日期变更；每次解析都新建 NumberFormatter。
rationale.可维护性: Large 阈值提成 largeAmountThreshold，三个地区各有 Preview；手写解析器偏长，未补测试。

rationale_en.结构与分层: Split into ExpenseDay, LocalMoney, ExpenseStore and the views: dates, money, data and UI each in their own place.
rationale_en.可读性: Comments explain parsing at local noon and why the system parser is too lenient; the generation logic in parse and recentAdds is dense.
rationale_en.一致性: KPI cards, status badges, the add sheet and page loading all use SW components, and expenses is added at the end of the enum as the docs instruct.
rationale_en.稳健写法: Strict whole-string amount parsing and local-noon date parsing, handles cancellation and date changes; creates a new NumberFormatter on every parse.
rationale_en.可维护性: The Large threshold is a named largeAmountThreshold, with a Preview for each of three regions; the hand-written parser is long and no tests were added.

rationale.结构与分层: ExpenseFormatting 包揽解析、日期、标签与月合计，store.log 还接收原始文本解析，层次略混。
rationale.可读性: 正则校验金额与日期清楚，行布局易懂；isLoading、isSaving 守卫在 store 和视图各写一遍。
rationale.一致性: SW 组件用法到位，但另起用 swiftc 单独编译运行的测试程序和 Tests/README.md，游离于工程之外。
rationale.稳健写法: 显式 MainActor、防重复提交、日期回转校验到位；币种回退 XXX，每行新建 DateFormatter。
rationale.可维护性: fetch、add 可注入便于测试且检查覆盖面广，但阈值 50 写死在视图里，测试要手动敲命令才能跑。

rationale_en.结构与分层: ExpenseFormatting handles parsing, dates, labels and monthly totals at once, and store.log also takes raw text to parse; the layers are somewhat mixed.
rationale_en.可读性: Regex validation of amounts and dates is clear and the row layout is easy to follow; the isLoading and isSaving guards are written twice, in the store and in the view.
rationale_en.一致性: SW components are used correctly, but the tests are a separate program compiled with swiftc plus a Tests/README.md, outside the project.
rationale_en.稳健写法: Explicit MainActor, double-submit guard and round-trip date validation; falls back to currency XXX and creates a DateFormatter for every row.
rationale_en.可维护性: fetch and add are injectable and the checks cover a lot, but the threshold 50 is hard-coded in the view and the tests must be run by hand.
